fields.name: face_limit
fields.title: Face Limit
fields.description: Target number of faces for the generated mesh. If not set, the model adaptively determines the count.

fields.name: texture
fields.title: Texture
fields.description: Whether to generate textures for the model.

fields.name: pbr
fields.title: Pbr
fields.description: Whether to generate PBR (Physically Based Rendering) materials. If true, texture is also enabled.

fields.name: texture_quality
fields.title: Texture Quality
fields.description: Quality level for textures. 'detailed' produces higher-resolution textures.

fields.name: texture_alignment
fields.title: Texture Alignment
fields.description: How textures are aligned. 'original_image' aligns to input image, 'geometry' aligns to generated geometry.

fields.name: auto_size
fields.title: Auto Size
fields.description: Auto-scale the model to real-world dimensions (meters).

fields.name: orientation
fields.title: Orientation
fields.description: Model orientation. 'align_image' auto-rotates to match the input image.

fields.name: quad
fields.title: Quad
fields.description: Generate quad (4-sided) mesh topology instead of triangles. When Tripo emits FBX bytes for quad output, the returned model file is FBX.
